title: metaspec-document/1
description: The data of one document's page as `metaspec render` writes it, in the page's <script type="application/json" id="metaspec-data"> element: the graph, the check by the pack's tool, the findings with the views they are drawn in, and one scene per view. `graph` follows metaspec-graph/1, each scene metaspec-scene/1, `check.result` metaspec-findings/1.

document.description: The path of the document relative to the pack.

page.description: The page's file relative to the output directory.

state.description: ran: the tool answered. no_tool, no_check: the manifest names no tool or no verb check. not_trusted: the user has not trusted this tool section (metaspec trust). timed_out: the run went over its deadline and was killed. refused: the answer holds the text the adapter's error points at. failed: not started, or an answer the adapter cannot read.

result.description: The tool's answer as the adapter read it, metaspec-findings/1.

n.description: The number its marks show, from 1.

drawn_in.description: The ids of the views whose scene marks it.
